name: Geosciences High School Summer Camp
org: Virginia Tech Department of Geosciences with the Fralin Life Sciences Institute
what_you_do: A full week of solving real earth science problems. Study soil, water, earthquakes and volcanoes. Tour labs and design an exhibit for the Museum of Geosciences.
who_can_apply: Campers ages 15 to 18. The page lists no school or residency rules. Limit of 16 campers.
pay_detail: $120 for the week (2026). Two scholarships are available each week for families with financial need.
duration: One week, 9am to 4pm (2026: June 1 to 5), day camp, no overnight
deadline_text: 2026 camp ran June 1 to 5. No registration deadline and no 2027 dates posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up with the link on the STEM Summer Camp page. For a scholarship, email the contact on the page. That is kdivitto@vt.edu or the Fralin education director.
notes: The same page lists camps for younger ages; only the Geosciences camp for ages 15 to 18 is for teens. The page shows 2026 details, so confirm before planning for 2027.
